execution: Two independent Codex collaboration subagents, each assigned the same 12-task batch.
model_control: Both inherit the parent model with no model or reasoning override; exact effective model ID is not exposed by the collaboration response.
exposure_control: Neither executor receives research, expected fixes, rubric, or external contract tests.
task_order: t01 through t12 in both arms; tasks within an arm share a conversation.

seed_result.interpretation: Initial fixtures contain unfinished requested changes; this is not the completed baseline arm.

harness_note: During executor runs, added a read/close-only resource check and non-app file-change capture to both arms. t10's original implementation supports that interface. Executors did not receive this change.
limitations: Synthetic Python tasks adapted from research; no production-repository replay.
Single grouped run, no randomization or per-task fresh contexts.
Token usage and full tool-call traces were not exposed; no measured speedup claim.
